entries.value: An often-used catchphrase or verbal tic
Always drinking or near a drink
Hands never stop moving
Talks very slowly and deliberately
Tends to shift weight constantly, never still
Has an unusual hairstyle, beard, or markedly unfashionable look
Appears often to be slightly drunk or in a reverie
Prefers always to be in shadow or away from windows
Asks far too many questions
Never looks you in the eye when lying
Visibly hungry for gold, food, or attention
Always circuitous about answering questions directly
Never directly refuses or denies anything
Paces constantly; always prefers to stand
Has work-stained or scarred hands
Old disease scars or pox marks on the face
Prefers elaborate hats, belts, or jewelled adornments
Always toying with rosary beads, a ring, or a coin
Knocks things over carelessly
Checks written notes or tallies regularly
